questions: Are your symptoms worse on one side of your body than the other?
Do you have a resting tremor (shaking) in your hands?
Have you fallen more than once in the past year?
Do you have difficulty looking downward with your eyes?
Did your symptoms begin gradually over months to years?
Have you noticed a loss of your sense of smell?
Do you act out your dreams while sleeping (punching, kicking, talking)?
Do you feel lightheaded or dizzy when you stand up?
Do you have problems with urinary urgency, frequency, or incontinence?
Have you ever been treated with levodopa (Sinemet) and did it clearly help your symptoms?
Have you ever taken an antipsychotic or anti-nausea medication such as haloperidol, risperidone, or metoclopramide?
Do you have memory or thinking problems that interfere with daily activities?
Do you see or hear things that other people do not see or hear?
Is there a family history of Parkinson's disease or a similar movement disorder?
Have you lost your ability to swallow liquids or solids without coughing or choking?
